lines.text: User docs move in the same change as their code: update the pages, retake the shots it made wrong with the capture harness (never by hand), and put `Docs: <pages>` or `Docs: none, <why>` in the commit or PR (/agentic-engineering:docs sync). Writer contract: .agents/docs-contract.md.
A README is written or cut down with /agentic-engineering:docs readme, which holds its length and order.

A new module gets its `@system node` line and a new call between modules its `@system calls` line in the same commit, then /agentic-engineering:docs map-sync regenerates the map (system-map.mjs --write); an import that needs no edge takes a `Diagram: none, <why>` line.
A Miro board drawn from code is linted before it is published and checked live after (/agentic-engineering:docs miro); layout moved on the board is pulled back, content changes in code.
